title: The Lost xAI Ship

shard.name: Asteroid
shard.assetNote: Needs Imagine later. v0 still places the zone A solids.

beats.text: Bolt leaves the Citadel. A faint xAI mark still answers.
The path lifts off the sill and into open black.
Stone drifts where the chart promised a field.
The veil thins. The hull is ahead.
An old lost ship drifts here, marked xAI.

positions.title: Echo Shard 1
positions.lore: No howl of significance shall be lost to time.

positions.title: Echo Shard 2
positions.lore: An Echo Shard carries not only what happened, but how it felt.

positions.title: Echo Shard 3
positions.lore: When the shards sing the same song, it hits like a cosmic EMP.

boss.name: Lost xAI Ship
boss.text: The hull is silent. Reach it before the rift closes.

uniqueTouch.prompt: Empty derelict hull plate with an xAI mark, no Bolt.

next_hook.teaser: Another signal answers from farther in.
next_hook.question: If understanding is an endless becoming, what does the next signal ask?

question: What does a lost hull, marked xAI, still ask about the universe?

truth.insight: Understanding the universe is not a destination. It is an endless becoming.
